scenario: An external SIGINT reaches an active TUI process -> the process exits without leaving alternate screen, disabling bracketed paste, or restoring the cursor.
fix: Route SIGINT through one cancellation and terminal-stop path and preserve signal exit status.
verification: Packed PTY test sends SIGINT and asserts cleanup sequences plus exit status.
costIfShipped: 1 of 1 externally interrupted terminal sessions remains altered
savedIfFixed: 1 of 1 externally interrupted terminal sessions restored

scenario: initialize requestId=same followed by get_state requestId=same -> the second body executes and emits a second response instead of conflict or replay.
evidence: targeted runRpc probe emitted two state responses for requestId=same
fix: Keep a per-connection canonical request digest and direct-response record; replay identical bodies and reject changed bodies.
verification: JSONL tests cover identical and changed-body request ID reuse.

scenario: Complete A, complete B, replay A -> acknowledgement revision is 15 but completion revision is 8 and omits B.
fix: Store completion only, then take current state after the original operation settles.
verification: Application and JSONL tests replay A after B and assert revision 15 with four messages.
costIfShipped: 1 of 1 delayed operation replays returns stale state
savedIfFixed: 1 of 1 delayed operation replays returns current state

defect: Predictable state temporary file follows symlinks
scenario: An attacker pre-creates target.pid.tmp as a symlink -> recordState truncates the symlink target before rename.
evidence: src/bin/braid.ts:19-27 uses deterministic path plus writeFile without exclusive or no-follow flags
fix: Create a random same-directory file with O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW, mode 0600, then atomically rename and clean up failures.
verification: Packed subprocess test pre-creates the former predictable symlink and proves its target is unchanged.
costIfShipped: 1 target file overwritten per won race
savedIfFixed: 1 target file protected per won race

scenario: Provider text includes U+200E, U+200F, or U+061C -> invisible direction controls reach terminal labels and can reorder visible text.
evidence: sanitizer probe preserved 3 of 3 tested controls
fix: Remove the complete Unicode Bidi_Control property set.
verification: Table-driven sanitizer test covers every code point in Bidi_Control.

defect: Aborted and blocked runs have wrong global status
scenario: Abort -> status failed; blocked final without error -> status ready.
evidence: targeted view probes reproduced 2 of 2 wrong statuses
fix: Derive explicit running, failed, blocked, aborted, and ready states from the latest run.
verification: View tests assert aborted and blocked labels and colors.
savedIfFixed: 2 of 2 non-success terminal states labeled correctly

defect: Ctrl+C order violates the documented composer behavior
scenario: Active run plus draft -> first Ctrl+C cancels instead of clearing; idle empty composer -> first Ctrl+C exits instead of arming a second press.
fix: Clear composer first, cancel only when empty, and require a timed second idle press to exit.
verification: TUI test covers all four documented Ctrl+C branches.
costIfShipped: 2 of 4 documented Ctrl+C branches are wrong

defect: Malformed optional parameters are silently ignored
scenario: send branchId=42 -> request succeeds against the current branch instead of INVALID_PARAMS.
evidence: targeted runRpc probe returned ack and completed state for numeric branchId
fix: Reject present fields of the wrong type and reject unknown keys for every W0 command.
verification: JSONL malformed-parameter table covers wrong optional types and unknown keys.
costIfShipped: 1 of 1 malformed optional fields tested is accepted
savedIfFixed: 1 of 1 malformed optional fields tested is rejected

defect: Operation map retains one full state snapshot per completed operation
scenario: Complete an operation, drop caller references, force GC -> the resolved state remains reachable from the operation map.
fix: Store Promise<void> and minimal operation metadata; materialize state only for the caller receipt.
verification: WeakRef GC test proves the completion snapshot is collectible while replay still works.
costIfShipped: n full state snapshots retained for n operations
savedIfFixed: n of n stored full state snapshots removed
